description: EarthSciIntegrator run config for reseact.esm (spec/run-config.md). Names the roles of the grid's index sets for the planner: lon and lat horizontal, lev vertical. Without this, the planner's default makes every index set that shapes a state horizontal, which is more than two here and is refused (axes_unresolved, spec/plan.md section 5.2.1). Everything else is automatic; the 300 s macro step and the 01:30Z start, 1 h window, match run_reseact.jl's defaults (RESEACT_MACRO_DT, RESEACT_T0).
